scenes.headline: How Nar TTS teaches a language model to speak
scenes.sub: Mimi speech tokens, a GRPO reward mix, and a quality gate at inference.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Jellybean! Nar TTS turns a causal language model into a text-to-speech system, then trains and checks it carefully. Here's how.

scenes.label: The rule
scenes.text: Never judge with the model you trained against: training rewards, verification and release checks each use a different judge.
scenes.say: The rule running through it: never judge with the model you trained against. Training, verification and release checks each use a different judge.

scenes.title: From text to a verified WAV

steps.say: Text goes into whichever causal language model you choose. Emotions and laughter are plain text markup, so the tokenizer never changes.
The model writes Mimi speech tokens, which decode to audio, with no model-specific config files.
It makes two candidates and checks them with Whisper, a different recognizer from the one used as a training reward.
The best one wins. Only if the gate fails does it make two more, and it saves every candidate with a report.

items.say: Training starts with pretraining, sharded across GPUs, with LoRA as an option.
An optional fine-tune is where expressive markup gets learned. The current checkpoint hasn't learned it yet.
Then optional GRPO: eight generations per prompt, each scored against the rest of its group.

scenes.title: Two rewards, built and held at zero

left.title: Six rewards switched on
left.say: Six rewards are on: sixty percent intelligibility, fifteen percent speaker similarity, and four smaller terms, each normalized within its group.

right.title: Emotion and events: weight zero
items: The same classifier is the success metric
right.say: Emotion and event rewards are built, but held at zero: their classifier is also the success metric, so the model would learn to please it.

scenes.text: Keep the judge apart from the reward, or the model learns to please the judge instead of the listener.
scenes.say: Keep the judge apart from the reward, or the model learns to please the judge instead of the listener.

recap: Any causal LM writes Mimi speech tokens
Two candidates, four only when the gate fails
Emotion rewards wait for an independent judge
scenes.say: To recap: any language model writing Mimi tokens, retries only when the gate fails, and rewards awaiting an independent judge.
